setup.title: Set up your interview
setup.subtitle: Your choices are saved automatically and used when the interview starts.

interview.cameraInUse: Camera is already in use by another app.

room.closed: It was closed and can no longer be resumed.
room.resumeProgress: You are on question {{question}} in the {{stage}} stage. Your progress is saved.
room.intro: The AI will ask questions one at a time. Answer by voice or by typing.
room.conflictTitle: You already have an interview in progress.
room.conflictText: Resume it, or discard it and start the new one.

auth.registerSubtitle: Start practicing in under a minute.
auth.passwordHint: 8+ characters with a letter and a number.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is where your interview practice stands.
dashboard.completeForScore: Complete an interview to get a score
dashboard.inProgress: You have a session in progress.
dashboard.firstText: Choose a role and set up a session. It takes about a minute.
dashboard.reviewText: Your average is below 60. Read your reports to see where to focus.
dashboard.raiseText: You are scoring well. Try a harder session or a different role.
dashboard.emptyHistory: Your completed and in-progress sessions will show up here.
dashboard.noActivity: Nothing yet. Activity appears after your first session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Security, language and notifications.
settings.languageText: Changes the website language and your default language for interviews.
settings.practiceDescription: Occasional nudges to keep your streak going.
settings.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes your account and all interview history. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Enter your password to permanently delete your account and all of your data.

interviews.title: My interviews
interviews.subtitle: Every session you have started, in one place.
interviews.tryFilters: Try a different search or clear the filters.
interviews.emptyText: Once you start an interview, it will be listed here with its score and report.

progress.weaknessText: Topics flagged most often in your answers
progress.firstLatest: First completed interview compared with your latest
